analysis: A1 suite-size and task-choice sensitivity (existing data only, no model runs)

meta.rng: Python random.Random (Mersenne Twister). Independent instances, each seeded with SEED: (1) part 1 primary curve, k = 3..15 in order; (2) part 1 live-task variant, k = 3..14 in order; (3) part 2, 39-pool draws then 164-pool draws
meta.sampling_part1: for each k, all C(15,k) subsets if C(15,k) <= 1000, otherwise 1000 distinct subsets sampled uniformly without replacement from all C(15,k)
meta.sampling_part2: 1000 suites of 15 tasks, each drawn uniformly without replacement from the pool; suites drawn independently (duplicates counted)

scaling_rules.stage_one: flag iff s < 0.6k (5s < 3k); k=15 gives s < 9
scaling_rules.defect_suspect: 15s <= 2k and 15b >= 8k (i.e. s <= 2k/15, b >= 8k/15; exact rationals, no rounding); k=15 gives s <= 2, b >= 8
scaling_rules.baseline: median subset score of the artifact's model+size siblings whose tag contains q6_K, q8_0, fp16 or f16 (analyze.py HIGH), official channel only
scaling_rules.grouping: analyze.py size_key (norm_model, norm_size), executed from its source
scaling_rules.stage_two_scope: applied to stage-one flagged artifacts; a suspect always has s <= 2k/15 < 0.6k so it is always flagged
